resources.string: Genie
Pair a genie
Your genie can run any command inside LinuxDesk and control its browser. It cannot reach other apps, and it gets no Android root. Pair only your own genie. You can unpair it here at any time.

If you also give LinuxDesk access to all your files, a command inside LinuxDesk may be able to read, change or delete them without the review screen. Deletes your genie asks for through LinuxDesk itself still need your tap.

Genie access
Off by default. When on, your paired genie can connect while the LinuxDesk session runs. It can act while LinuxDesk is on screen, or was within the last 2 minutes (the switch below changes this).
Recommendations (off until you approve)
The defaults work like Storage Genie. These are extra rules we recommend. Each one stays off until you turn it on.
Allow while the session runs — off by default

Off by default. Off: like Storage Genie, your genie can act only while LinuxDesk is on screen, or was within the last 2 minutes. On: it can act whenever the LinuxDesk session runs, also in the background.
Refuse while locked — off by default
Off by default. On: your genie cannot run commands or use the mouse and keyboard while the phone is locked.
All-files access or Genie access, not both — off by default
Off by default. On: Genie access cannot be turned on while LinuxDesk has access to all your files, so a command inside LinuxDesk cannot reach your files without your approval.
Developer: local link
Off by default. For testing over USB only: a link on 127.0.0.1:8766 (adb forward tcp:8766 tcp:8766). It still needs your pairing.
Turn off All-files access first

The \"All-files access or Genie access, not both\" guard is on, and LinuxDesk has access to all your files. Turn off All-files access for LinuxDesk in Android Settings, or turn the guard off, then try again.
